findings.title: Google updateEvent fallback can never resolve
findings.body: In updateEvent, file packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts line 254, selectedCalendar is computed as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When externalCalendarId is falsy the else-branch searches for `externalId === externalCalendarId` which is falsy, so it never matches and selectedCalendar becomes undefined. The previous code fell back to `event.destinationCalendar.externalId`. The result is calendarId undefined passed to `calendar.events.update`, causing update failures.

findings.title: Google deleteEvent fallback can never resolve
findings.body: In deleteEvent, file packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts line 315, calendarId is computed as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When externalCalendarId is missing the fallback compares against the same missing value, never matches, and yields undefined, so deletion falls back to "primary" instead of the stored destination calendar. This deletes from the wrong calendar or silently misses the event.

findings.title: Crash when destinationCalendar is empty with Google Meet location
findings.body: In file packages/core/EventManager.ts line 119, code does `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []; if (evt.location === MeetLocationType && mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== ...)`. If destinationCalendar is null, undefined, or empty, the destructured value is undefined and accessing `.integration` throws TypeError. This crashes booking creation for events with no destination calendar. It needs optional chaining.

findings.title: Null destinationCalendar drops collective hosts calendars
findings.body: In file packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts around line 1063, evt.destinationCalendar is built as `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [...] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [...] : null`. When both are missing it is null, but later code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` for COLLECTIVE events. Optional chaining on null skips the push, so the collected team/host destination calendars are silently lost and only the organizer calendar (or none) is used, defeating the multi-host fix.

findings.title: Non-Google calendars ignore per-credential calendar for multi-host
findings.body: In file packages/lib/CalendarService.ts line 156 and similarly packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts line 73 and packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts line 128, createEvent only uses the first entry `[mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar`. EventManager now loops over each destination and calls createEvent with the host-specific credential and externalId, but these services ignore the credentialId/externalId and always write to the first host's externalId. For collective events the second host's event is created in the wrong calendar or fails, while only GoogleCalendarService was updated to select by credentialId.

findings.title: Recurring cancel only deletes organizer calendars
findings.body: In file packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts around line 449, when cancelling all remaining recurring bookings the code iterates `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(c => c.type.endsWith("_calendar"))` to delete each updatedBooking reference. For collective events created with multiple hosts, references now belong to other hosts' credentials which are not in the organizer's credential list, so those calendar events are never deleted and leak on external calendars.

findings.title: Webhook expectations still expect null destinationCalendar
findings.body: In file apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts line 119 (BOOKING_CREATED) and line 373 (BOOKING_REQUESTED) the expected payload still asserts `destinationCalendar: null`, while the type was changed to `DestinationCalendar[]` and other code now emits `[]`. Only the BOOKING_REJECTED case was updated. The stale expectations will fail and mask the contract break for webhook consumers changing from null/object to array.
